what: The photo card group stands in accent duotone — grayscale (saturation 0 · opacity .8) overlaid with two layers, a dark-ink difference blend and an accent screen blend. Hovering one card lifts both layers from that card only, the color returns and the hidden second photo (normally 20%) shows fully, while the other cards recede to photo 30% · second photo 5% · label 0 — all .3s cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1)

options.--fx-dim: Photo opacity of the receded card, default .3
options.--fx-deep: Difference blend layer color, near-black derived from the default ink color (original #28292a)
options.[data-fx-part=alt]: Second photo in the card (optional) — normally overlaps at 20%, fully visible on hover. Laid over the photo with absolute
options.[data-fx-part=label]: Text on the card (optional) — disappears when hovering another card

from.where: index.html · about.html .od-cards (concern and treatment two-cell screen-height cards, method two-cell cards) — original bg-ebony mix-blend-difference + bg-blue mix-blend-screen + black 10%, group-hover/links

note: The original lays one more 10% ink layer — the part gets the same darkness with brightness(.9) on the photo. On touch devices (no hover) it stays duotone and does not change
